title: Lovely Roasted Syrian Pasta
description: A traditional Syrian dish featuring roasted bowtie pasta in a rich braise, served with a glassy jelly sauce, this recipe is a nostalgic and halal-friendly delight.
instructions: Preheat the binchotan grill to medium-high heat.
Cook the bowtie pasta according to package instructions until al dente, then set aside.
In a large bowl, whisk together the olive oil, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chopped onion to the bowl and toss to coat with the oil mixture.
Grill the onion mixture on the binchotan grill for 5 minutes, or until the onions are lightly charred.
In a large skillet, cook the ground beef over medium heat until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the minced garlic, tomato paste, beef broth, and pomegranate molasses to the skillet and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in the cooked pasta and grilled onion mixture, and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Serve the pasta hot, garnished with a glassy jelly sauce made by reducing the pomegranate molasses over low heat until thickened.
Cook ground beef to an internal temperature of 71°C / 160°F (no longer pink in the middle) before serving.
